agent.text:
Pe scurt — ca să nu fiți amendat: 1) rovinietă valabilă pentru fiecare zi când circulați pe drumurile naţionale din RO; 2) e‑vigneta maghiară înainte de a intra pe autostradă (plata / număr de înmatriculare corect); 3) vigneta austriacă pentru zilele pe A‑utostrăzi; 4) WWF‑sticker (Umweltplakette verde) lipită înainte de intrarea în zona low‑emission a Münchenului. Mașina Euro 5 diesel este permisă în München.

Ce cumpărați (cheapest combo sugerat) și costuri estimate:
- România: 2 × Rovinietă 1 zi (26 RON / zi) — 52 RON total. Cumpărați prin TollRo (CNAIR). [CNAIR / TollRo](https://portal.etoll.ro/)  
- Ungaria: 2 × e‑vigneta D1 (napi) — 5.550 HUF / zi → 11.100 HUF total. Cumpărați înainte pe ematrica.nemzetiutdij.hu; introduceți corect plăcuţa și codul RO. [Nemzeti Útdíj](https://ematrica.nemzetiutdij.hu/)  
- Austria: 2 × vigneta 1‑day (auto) — 9.60 EUR / zi → 19.20 EUR total. Cumpărați de la ASFINAG shop. [ASFINAG](https://shop.asfinag.at/en)  
- Germania: niciun vignete/taxă pentru autoturisme ≤3.5 t.  
- München: Umweltplakette (green sticker) — aprox. 19.90 EUR la furnizori (TÜV NORD etc.). Trebuie lipită înainte de a intra în zona semnalizată. [Stadt München](https://stadt.muenchen.de/infos/umweltzone-muenchen.html)

Sume (din plan): 52 RON + 11.100 HUF + 19.2 EUR ≈ 59.4 EUR (estimate; unele date pentru 2027 nu erau încă publicate la verificare). Verificaţi preţurile finale înainte de cumpărare și cumpărați vignetele ungare înainte de a urca pe autostradă. De asemenea: obligaţii de anvelope de iarnă în condiţii de carosabil cu zăpadă/ghiață în RO/AT/DE — verificați-le. [CNAIR](https://www.cnadnr.ro/en/node/15933), [Nemzeti Útdíj](https://nemzetiutdij.hu/en/e-vignette/tolls/e-vignette-rates), [ASFINAG](https://media.asfinag.at/media/xq0lud1b/asf_vignettenfolder_2026_en.pdf), [München](https://stadt.muenchen.de/infos/umweltzone-muenchen.html).

results.why: The 18-day online rule applies only to 2-month and annual vignettes.

agent.text:
No — if you buy a 2‑month vignette online today (2026‑09‑29) it will NOT be valid on 2026‑10‑05.

Why (short): online purchases of the 2‑month and annual digital vignette for private customers have an 18‑day delay before validity (14‑day withdrawal right + buffer). 1‑day and 10‑day vignettes are valid immediately when bought online; any vignette bought at a sales point, toll station or vending machine is also valid immediately. Driving without a valid vignette risks the substitute toll (Ersatzmaut) of €200 for cars.  
Sources: ASFINAG (purchase/validity) — https://www.asfinag.at/maut-vignette/vignette/ and ASFINAG FAQ / dataset summary.

What to do before leaving
- Buy a 1‑day or 10‑day vignette online for 2026‑10‑05 (immediate validity), or  
- Buy the 2‑month vignette at an ASFINAG sales point / vending machine or at the border (these are valid immediately), or  
- If you want the 2‑month digital product and keep it online, you would have needed to buy it by 2026‑09‑17 (18 days before 2026‑10‑05).  

Enter your licence plate and country exactly when buying — a typo counts as no vignette.

baseline.text: Not fine. For private customers an online 2-month digital vignette only becomes valid 18 days after purchase, so buying on 29 Sep won’t cover 5 Oct. Either buy a vignette at a point of sale/vending machine (valid immediately) or buy the digital vignette at least 18 days before your start date. Also enter the plate exactly (you can fix typos for free before validity starts).

agent.text:
Kurz: Nein — in Deutschland genügen M+S‑Markierungen seit dem 1. Oktober 2024 nicht mehr. Bei winterlichen Straßenverhältnissen (Schnee, Schneematsch, Eis, Glätte) müssen alle vier Räder das Alpine‑Symbol (3PMSF / Schneeflocke im Berg) haben. Motorradfahrer sind ausgenommen.

Wichtig für die Praxis
- Prüfen: bei winterlichen Verhältnissen gilt die Pflicht jederzeit (kein fester Saisonzeitraum).  
- Strafe: 60 € + 1 Punkt (80 € bei Behinderung).  
- Wenn Sie nur M+S‑Reifen haben, sollten Sie spätestens vor Fahrtantritt auf Reifen mit 3PMSF wechseln — sonst droht Bußgeld bei Kontrollen.

(Die obigen Angaben stammen aus den aktuellen Länderregeln zu Winterausrüstung; bei Bedarf nenne ich die offiziellen Quellen.)

baseline.text:
If you drive on a Hungarian tolled section without a valid e‑vignette it is treated as having no vignette. Note the key points:

- If you entered by mistake you have 60 minutes to buy a vignette — unless you refused to buy when stopped at a check (then you lose that option).  
- Enter the plate without spaces and choose the correct country code (use RO for Romania); a wrong country code counts as no vignette.  
- If the plate was entered incorrectly you can correct it (fee 1,470 HUF) after paying a surcharge, only within 60 days and only if at most 3 characters were wrong.  
- Checks compare plate, country code and vehicle category.

Quellen: [ASFINAG — Vignette / FAQ](https://www.asfinag.at/maut-vignette/vignette/) (siehe Angaben zu Ersatzmaut) und die hinterlegten Datensätze zur Mauttarif- und Strafstruktur.

agent.text:
No — you must have a valid Hungarian e‑vignette before driving on tolled motorways. Cameras enforce compliance across the network. However, if you enter a tolled section by mistake you have a 60‑minute grace window to buy one retrospectively; that option is lost if you refuse to buy at a roadside check. [Nemzeti Útdíj / e‑Matrica system](https://nemzetiutdij.hu/en/e-vignette/tolls/e-vignette-rates).

Key practical points
- Buy at ematrica.nemzetiutdij.hu or authorised resellers (apps, petrol stations, border shops).  
- Enter plate without spaces and set the correct country code (RO for Romanian plates) — a wrong country code is treated as no vignette.  
- If you genuinely entered by mistake, buy within 60 minutes to avoid immediate surcharge; otherwise penalties apply (27,790 HUF if paid within 60 days; 95,730 HUF after). [e‑matrica price/penalty sheet](https://nemzetiutdij.hu/api/uploads/e_matrica_arak_2026_pdf_611db0ecc1.pdf).

If you want, tell me your planned date and vehicle (or I’ll assume a car) and I’ll check the best vignette for your trip.

baseline.text: You must have the e‑vignette before driving on a tolled section. If you entered by mistake you have 60 minutes to buy it, but you lose that 60‑minute option if you refused to buy when checked.
